post.title: Where your mattress money goes: 47¢ to sell, 41¢ to make
post.ig:
This mattress company spent more selling beds than making them.

In 2025, Sleep Number's gross margin was 59.0%, so making its beds cost 41.0 cents per sales dollar.
Sales and marketing took 47.1 cents per dollar, and it posted a $47 million operating loss.
It filed for Chapter 11 in June 2026 and was bought by Sleep Country Canada in July 2026.
FTC pricing guides say a crossed-out price should be a real former price. In 2025, Mattress Firm, which denies wrongdoing, settled a California suit over allegedly fake discounts at $40 per online order.

Sources: Sleep Number 2025 Form 10-K, US Bankruptcy Court SDNY filings, FTC Guides Against Deceptive Pricing (16 CFR 233), Hampton v. Mattress Firm settlement.
